rule: Frozen before the first training capture (P3 note section 8 item 3). A change is a new file version, labelled post hoc; tests/test_p3_prereg.py pins every value.

volume.eval_tail_note: evaluation captures only: the 240 s slot after the core phases holds C3b@M3 and the held-out benign kinds, and the 120 s benign tail follows it as in every capture, so 60 + 3 x 240 + 240 + 120 = 1140 s
volume.eval_tail_label: re-registered 2026-10-31 under D-034, before any capture (T038-01): 1020 -> 1140 s; with key lifetimes from one law (ml/l7v2_prereg.json arrivals.lifetimes), an M3 bot needs the tail after its slot that the last core slot has, or its lifetimes, and so its window ages, are cut short (window-age AUC 0.31 at seed 3201 without it)
volume.benign_users_min_note: re-registered 2026-10-31 by the user, before any capture: 200 -> 120 users per capture seed (200 do not fit the 300 verified aliases next to the L7 v2 classes; T-025a F3)
